description: This file defines an interface named TaskQueueInterface within the GuzzleHttpomise namespace, outlining methods for managing a task queue such as checking if it is empty, adding tasks, and executing them.

classes.name: TaskQueueInterface
classes.description: An interface that specifies methods for task queue management including checking if the queue is empty, adding tasks, and running all tasks.

methods.name: isEmpty
methods.description: Returns true if the queue is empty.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Adds a task to the queue that will be executed the next time run is called.

methods.name: run
methods.description: Execute all of the pending tasks in the queue.
